messages:
toni: Heads up — canary firmware push in eu-west1 flipped UEFI SecureBoot on the BMCs for rack-12. ~18 nodes are stuck at the UEFI prompt and KVM consoles are unresponsive. Provisioner shows GPU pool for rack-12 unhealthy, requests failing allocation. Anyone oncall?

sre-oncall: I'm on it, starting log collection and contacting ops for OOB console access.

alex: If the BMC changed the boot policy to prefer local disk with SecureBoot enabled, PXE will refuse unsigned boot. Can you grab BMC state from one host? `ipmitool mc info` + `bmc-config --get secureboot` would help.

toni: grabbing now, pasting from host gpu-12-07: 
```
# ipmitool mc info
Device ID                 : 32
Device Revision           : 1
Firmware Revision         : 2.13
Manufacturer ID           : 674
IPMI Version              : 2.0
Manufacturer Name         : AcmeBMC
Product ID                : 1234
GUID                      : 9a3f...
# bmc-config --get secureboot
secureboot: enabled
```

jamie: pausing the fleet rollout now — put the canary batch on hold in the deployment dashboard. @deploy-bot can you confirm rollback/hold?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused for tag `fw/2026-03-19` by jamie. No further waves will be scheduled. :white_check_mark:

maria: Ops ran `bmc-util set-secureboot off` over IPMI on 12 hosts so far; 10 came back to PXE and reprovisioned successfully. 2 are still stuck with KVM session hung (console shows "UEFI Interactive Shell"). Need remote KVM power-cycle.

ops-bot: KVM reset requests queued to jump-host pool. ETA 6m for first reset.

alex: Good catch on the signing pipeline — looks like the new image accidentally set the secureboot flag in the flash metadata. Recommend rolling back to previous signed image and revoking the flag in the firmware builder. Also add an assert in the preflight that checks `secureboot` default state for canaries.

toni: Agreed. I'll create a rollback patch and a quick runbook for manual remediation: 1) set secureboot off, 2) boot to PXE, 3) reprovision, 4) mark node back healthy.

sre-oncall: Also spinning up 4 spare GPU nodes in eu-west1 to cover capacity while we triage. Heads-up on cost: if the spares stay up for 48h we estimate ~ $1.2k extra.

jamie: Noted — cost accepted to avoid SLA impact. Please record exact uptime for chargeback.

maria: After the KVM resets 2/2 recovered. Total: 12 fixed by OOB toggle, 6 unaffected, 2 required KVM reset. Rack-12 GPU pool back to 96% capacity, provisioning errors dropping.

toni: Filing incident ticket (INC-2026-045) and will draft a short postmortem. Action items: pause rollout, add preflight secureboot check, revert pipeline change, add automated remediation script to flip secureboot off via trusted IPMI key when canary fails.

alex: Also add a monitoring alert for sudden UEFI prompt frequency + KVM-session timeouts so we catch this faster.

jamie: thumbs up. Thanks team — great response. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary hold remains in place. Resume only after manual approval from eng-infra and SRE leads.

toni: Closing thread for now, will update incident once postmortem is ready.
